title: Agent 3 — Repair Guide Output
description: Output contract for the Car Sound Doctor Repair Guide Agent (Agent 3). See AGENT_3_IMPLEMENTATION.md §7. v3 additions (applicability, parts_to_replace, diagnosis_only status, per-step applicability_scope) are OPTIONAL so that P6-v1 and P6-v2 outputs remain schema-valid.

case_id.description: Non-empty identifier matching the incoming case.

status.description: Overall outcome. 'diagnosis_only' (v3) means the fault is identified and inspection steps exist, but no replacement/repair procedure was retrieved.

engine.description: Optional engine/trim descriptor echoed from the case record. Accepted because models routinely copy it from the input; it is not used for validation.

certainty.description: Level of diagnostic certainty. Use confirmed_by_evidence only when sources and checks genuinely support it.

evidence_summary.description: Brief summary of the supporting evidence for this fault hypothesis.

applicability.description: v3: how broadly the guide applies, derived from retrieved source metadata. Optional for backward compatibility with P6-v1/v2.

scope.description: Narrowest scope supported by the cited evidence. Never wider than the union of cited source derived_scope values.

note.description: Plain-language justification for the scope claim, naming any restricting condition.

source_ids.description: Source IDs that support the applicability claim.

parts_to_replace.description: v3: named physical components involved, with the role the source gives them. Empty for insufficient_information and professional_assistance_required.

name.description: Specific component name as it appears in the cited source (translated to output language is allowed), e.g. 'accessory drive belt', 'idler pulley'.

role.description: replace = source instructs replacement; inspect = check condition; suspect = named as a likely cause with no procedure (diagnosis_only only).

part_number.description: Only populate when the exact part number appears in the cited source text. Otherwise null.

source_id.description: Retrieved source whose text names this component.

tools.description: List of tools required for the repair procedure.

action.description: Non-empty description of what to do. v3: must name the component where a component is involved.

source_id.description: ID of the retrieved source that supports this step.

page.description: Page number in the source document, or null if non-paginated.

warning.description: Optional safety warning specific to this step.

applicability_scope.description: v3: how broadly THIS step applies, derived from the derived_scope of the passages it cites.

safety_warnings.description: Top-level safety warnings applicable to the entire procedure.

limitations.description: Known limitations, caveats, or gaps in the guide.

allOf.$comment: Abstention statuses must carry no repair steps and no replacement parts.

steps.description: Steps must be empty when status is not guide_available or diagnosis_only.

parts_to_replace.description: No parts may be listed when no guide is provided.

allOf.$comment: v3: diagnosis_only may suggest inspection or suspicion, never an outright replacement.
